OUR PHILOSOPHY

Of the island.
Of the season.
Of the moment.

At SERA, the Mediterranean is more than a view. It is the starting point: salt on the breeze, the warmth of the earth, the quiet generosity of an island.

Our imagined kitchen follows a simple idea. Choose beautiful ingredients. Treat them with care. Leave just enough room for surprise.

THE OTHER HALF OF THE STORY

A sense of place.
In every glass.

Island vines. Small producers. Unexpected discoveries. Our concept cellar travels from Mallorca to the wider Mediterranean, with every pour chosen to continue the conversation on your plate.

Discover the wine pairing · €65

Six considered pours, from a mineral island white to an elegant red and a final sweet note. A sample pairing for Terra i Mar; wines would change with the season.

The alcohol-free journey · €35

Six pairings built around verjus, orchard fruits, botanical infusions and carefully balanced acidity. Every bit as considered.

THE PACE

Allow 2½–3 hours
for the tasting experience

A few thoughtful details.

Can the menu accommodate dietary needs?

The Garden is our vegetarian concept menu. For a real booking, the team would discuss allergies and dietary requirements with you in advance. No dish in this demo is certified allergen-free.

What is the dress code?

Relaxed elegance. Wear something that makes the evening feel a little special, and yourself completely comfortable.

Can I book for a special occasion?

Of course. The private dining concept is designed for 8–14 guests. Use “Plan a private evening” to explore an example enquiry.

Will this website make a real reservation?

No. SERA is a fictional restaurant and this is a design demonstration. The reservation flow does not send, save or confirm a real booking, and no payment is taken.
